name: RespondToWebhook
caption: Respond to Webhook

configuration.description: HTTP status code to return (200-599). The editor stores it as text so it may be a SmartField/SmartFormula; a JSON number is also accepted. If the resolved text is not an integer, 200 is used.
Content-Type header of the response, e.g. application/json, application/xml, text/plain. Missing/null defaults to application/json.
Response body. SmartText: SmartFields {{..}}, SmartFormulas [[..]] and SmartControls {#..#} are resolved before responding.

rules.check: statusCode is a required field in the config canvas (an empty value is saved as "200").
rules.message: Please fill in the highlighted fields.

rules.check: The status code should be between 200 and 599 (or a SmartField/SmartFormula that resolves to one). No editor, publish or run-time check enforces this: any integer is handed to the caller as is, and text that is not an integer becomes 200. The machine check accepts 200-599 or a value containing {{ or [[.
contentType must be non-empty (required canvas field). Note: an explicitly empty string is sent as an empty Content-Type at run time; only a missing key falls back to application/json.
rules.message: Please fill in the highlighted fields.

notes: Only offered in the step picker for flows whose trigger is Webhook ("trigger": 5564403). In other flows it has no caller to answer.
Only effective when the Webhook trigger's configuration.responseMode is "WaitForResponse". In "InstantReturn" mode the trigger has already answered the caller.
At run time the step hands status/content type/body to the waiting webhook call; steps after it continue asynchronously in the background. If it is the last step, the execution completes.
Not a terminating step: steps may follow it. The status code is not range-checked at run time.

In WaitForResponse mode the steps before this one run synchronously inside the caller's request: a failing step returns 500 with the error text to the caller, and a step that defers the run (Sleep) fails it. In InstantReturn mode the whole flow runs in the job queue and this step has no effect.
